question: Using the unchanged proposal, SAM2 and DINOv2 scorer, which of all fourteen pre-enumerated extra views place a target-overlapping proposal at Top-1 or within Top-3?

predecessor.single_change: Change only the query observation: enumerate every already frozen source-admitted extra view and rerun the unchanged proposal and score stack independently on each view.

proposal.selection: Union unchanged full-frame proposals with fixed 40-percent corner-tile proposals; no query truth access.

tiling.merge: Retain up to 16 full-frame and 8 per tile, remap to full-image coordinates, then score without NMS or truth filtering.

descriptor.feature: Final-layer foreground mean chooses among the same three target references; normalized foreground patches from zero-based DINOv2 block 18 supply the unchanged local score.

appearance.score: For the final-layer-selected target reference, average each query patch maximum cosine to reference foreground patches; fuse equally with final-layer target-memory score.

masker.contract: Apply unchanged native SAM2 to every retained proposal; truth evaluates ranking only after all scores are fixed.

evaluation.truth_role: Truth enters only after the complete per-view candidate ranking is fixed; oracle selection then chooses the best already evaluated extra view.

literature_motivation.source: PInVerify: An Offline Embodied Benchmark for Active Instance Verification
literature_motivation.use: Measure the oracle ceiling before training a view policy because tested random, angular-farthest and MLLM NBV strategies showed no reliable gain.

literature_motivation.source: Active Perception for Ambiguous Objects Classification
literature_motivation.use: Select for reduced ambiguity between similar candidates rather than visual clarity or distance alone.

forbidden_after_freeze: drop or add query views, change model bytes, proposals, masks, features, fusion, IoU gate or ranking after observing results
call a view informative merely because the target is visible; require target Top-1 or an explicitly reported margin
claim an oracle-selected view as a runnable selection policy or fresh transfer
claim_boundary: This materializes consumed-family per-view rankings for an oracle ceiling. It cannot establish a deployable active-view policy, fresh transfer, calibrated uncertainty, exact-instance binding, portal ownership, affordance, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
